stay.name: The Lisboans Apartments
stay.description: Boutique serviced apartments in a restored 19th-century factory in Lisbon’s historic centre, offering 1–2 bedroom units with kitchens, vintage design, and free breakfast.

slots.name: Lusophonica - Farol De Santa Marta
slots.why: Lusophonica - Farol De Santa Marta (Cafe): Coffee house and online radio in Cascais offering live music, cocktails, coffee, and light bites with dine-in, takeout, outdoor seating, and delivery.. Featuring lighthouse grounds, sunset view, independent music.

slots.name: Underdogs
slots.why: Underdogs (Attraction): Lisbon-based contemporary gallery and cultural platform presenting public art, limited artist editions, exhibitions and commissioned projects.. Featuring gallery space, art gallery, local cultural scenes. Dedicated spotlight for Aisha.

slots.name: Os Amigos Da Severa
slots.why: Os Amigos Da Severa (Restaurant): Traditional Lisbon eatery offering inexpensive Portuguese dishes with coffee, beer, wine and spirits; dine-in and delivery available.. Featuring authentic, dine in, delivery service.

slots.name: Museu de Lisboa - Casa dos Bicos
slots.why: Museu de Lisboa - Casa dos Bicos (Attraction): 16th-century Lisbon manor with distinctive diamond-point (beak) stone façade, now a museum and cultural space in the Alfama district.. Featuring getting tickets in advance recommended, afternoon, historic.

slots.name: Boutique Taberna
slots.why: Boutique Taberna (Restaurant): Cozy, inexpensive Lisbon bar-restaurant offering cocktails, dancing, arcade games, wine and a private dining room near Bairro Alto.. Featuring dine in, impulse visit, music enthusiasts. Dedicated spotlight for Rohan.

slots.name: Praça do Rossio
slots.why: Praça do Rossio (Attraction): Historic central square in Lisbon known for its wave-pattern pavement, lively atmosphere, and surrounding cafés and landmarks.. Featuring bright, midday, tourist attraction.

days.theme: Design Heritage, Taste Bridge & Sunset Gathering

slots.name: Casa das Histórias Paula Rego
slots.why: Casa das Histórias Paula Rego (Attraction): Museum showcasing Paula Rego's works from the 1950s–1990s housed in distinctive red, pyramid-shaped concrete towers designed by Eduardo Souto de Moura.. Featuring cafe, modern, paid parking lot.

slots.name: Church of Saint Mary of Bethlehem
slots.why: Church of Saint Mary of Bethlehem (Attraction): 16th-century Manueline-style Catholic church adjoining the Jerónimos Monastery at Praça do Império, a historic landmark in Lisbon's Belém waterfront.. Featuring wheelchair accessible parking lot, historic, art history. Dedicated spotlight for Meera.

slots.name: Bohemia Lx
slots.why: Bohemia Lx (Restaurant): Traditional Portuguese restaurant offering nightly live Fado performances in an intimate 18th-century stone-walled setting near Praça do Comércio.. Featuring city center, coffee and tea, takeout.

slots.name: A Vida Portuguesa
slots.why: A Vida Portuguesa (Shop): Curated shop of vintage-style Portuguese home goods, toiletries, and specialty food celebrating local craftsmanship and heritage in a design-focused retail setting.. Featuring product displays, historic, morning. Dedicated spotlight for Kabir.

slots.name: Quinta da Regaleira
slots.why: Quinta da Regaleira (Attraction): Early 20th-century palace complex with ornate gardens, grottoes and an iconic Initiation Well linked by subterranean tunnels, chapel, and museum.. Featuring culture arts, place, unique. Taste bridge for Aisha & Meera.

slots.name: São Miguel d'Alfama
slots.why: São Miguel d'Alfama (Restaurant): Traditional Fado venue in Alfama serving Portuguese cuisine with all-you-can-eat options, private dining, and a full bar.. Featuring narrow street view, atmospheric, evening.

shopping.name: A Vida Portuguesa
shopping.description: Curated shop of vintage-style Portuguese home goods, toiletries, and specialty food celebrating local craftsmanship and heritage in a design-focused retail setting.

hidden_gem.name: Museum of Contemporary Art – MAC/CCB
hidden_gem.description: Contemporary art museum in Belém showcasing modern international masters (Picasso, Bacon, Warhol) and rotating exhibitions within the Centro Cultural de Belém.

wildcard.name: Miradouro de Santa Catarina
wildcard.description: Hillside terrace garden and popular viewpoint offering panoramic Tagus River and city skyline views, casual seating, sunset vistas, and a laid-back local atmosphere.
